text:
Anya Patel: quick sync — customer demo requires twilight-13b onboarded next week. Benchmarks done but seeing 5-10% latency regression at ~2k tok vs current default. Customer X requested pin until Mar. Need to agree acceptance gates + pin policy. Thoughts?

Sahil Kumar: can you paste the perf numbers? rough rule: latency regress <=10% and quality regress <=2% on our eval set to pass. otherwise we need perf optimizations or quant profile

Jordan Li: +1 to Sahil. propose canary rollout: 5% traffic for 48hrs, monitor P50/P95, resample evals on incoming prompts. fallback routing -> previous model if error rate or latency spike > threshold. also add A/B quality runs for high-risk customers :eyes:

Maria G: infra note — dedicated pool capacity limited next week. if we can shift canary to region-west or schedule off-peak we can avoid blocking. also need to run KMS scan and E2E infra smoke

ops-bot: perf-run report: https://ci.redwood/testruns/4721 — p50 85ms -> 92ms, p95 240ms -> 270ms, cost +8% (quant profiles disabled). logs attached

Anya Patel: OK. draft acceptance gates: 1) perf: p95 <= +15% and no >2x tail spikes 2) quality: eval drift <=2% on core prompts 3) cost delta <=10% 4) security & KMS pass 5) migration docs + customer comm 6) canary plan (5% 48h + rollback trigger rules)

Sahil Kumar: pin policy question — customer wants pin until Mar. we should limit manual pins to enterprise SLAs. propose 'adaptive pin': initial pin 30d then auto-evaluate every 14d with opt-out. if customer pays enterprise SLA, allow fixed pin up to 90d with comms

Jordan Li: canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  duration_hours: 48
  metrics:
    - p50_latency
    - p95_latency
    - error_rate
    - quality_regression
  rollback_if:
    p95_latency_increase_pct > 20 || error_rate > 0.5%
```

Maria G: next steps — Sahil pls confirm acceptance thresholds in ticket #PL-2314, Jordan/Eng pls schedule canary region-west, Ops will run KMS + infra smoke on canary start. I'll draft customer comms for pin opt-in

Anya Patel: great. I'll create the PRD/launch checklist and assign owners. target decision meeting tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:

Sahil Kumar: ack

Jordan Li: ack
